title: 第十七章 五级御马凛冬之猎第十八章 剑室争端挑衅
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: 李奥看着自己即将解锁的【御马】技能。
【御马四级98100（精神+0.4，与马匹心意相通，骑马控制能力大幅提升，可读取马匹的记忆片段，读取内容和精神力相关）】
此时吹着骨笛，他脑中所想，那六匹马很快就能感应到。
原本他还只能感应一匹马，但是吹着骨笛的时候，李奥感觉自己能够一次性指挥六匹马。
正好他接下来要遛马。
他解开所有马的缰绳，将骨笛含在嘴里。
六匹马便乖乖地到了自己的面前。
李奥骑上属于自己的那匹白马。
此时他不需要用马鞭驱赶，也不需要不停地下命令，只需要轻轻地吹响骨笛。
伴随着清亮的笛声。
六匹马儿便像是完全被李奥掌控。
加速，减速，转弯。
六匹马在不大的马厩里不急不缓的转着圈，帮助他们消化刚刚吃下的草料。
有了这个骨笛的帮助，李奥感觉自己御马变得轻松了许多，如果自己精神力再继续变强，是不是能一次性操控更多的马。
而且此时，他不停地读取另外几匹马的记忆片段。
由于可以观察的时限变长，此时的他看到了不少之前看不到的画面。
其中一匹黑马的记忆里显示。
昨晚后半夜，拉福林的骑士侍从佐罗骑着那匹黑马，到城镇里杀死了一个长相怪异的兽人。
那是一个佝偻、精瘦的绿皮矮子。
李奥曾经在兽人图谱上看过那种兽人。
哥布林。
自从李奥怀疑自己上次遭遇了兽人。
他便想办法从城堡的文献室找来了一本兽人图谱，哥布林、狗头人、豺狼人、牛头人……
根据上面画的兽人画像。
李奥发现自己之前遇到的便是哥布林。
此时他看着记忆片段中，佐罗直接骑马到了一处民居。
接着便是下马冲进民居，一剑劈死了那哥布林，扛着尸体上马，回城堡复命。
像是执行任务。
“果然，这城镇里面有兽人在活动，只不过消息可能被掩盖，又或者自己这个层次还接触不到这些关于兽人的信息。”
李奥反复观看这段记忆片段。
整个片段里最吸引李奥的便是佐罗的剑术。
一剑干脆利落，劈断了哥布林格挡的木棍，将那小兽人自上而下，劈成了两片。
还有当时，李奥看到佐罗似乎整个人泛着青黑色，口鼻喷吐阵阵黑气。
“看起来像是一种呼吸法。”
正看着，不知不觉，马背上的李奥感觉自己面板一动。
content_en:
Leo looked at the [Horse Control] skill he was about to unlock.
[Horse Level 4 98100 (Spirit +0.4, connected with the horse's mind, greatly improved riding control ability, can read the horse's memory fragments, the read content is related to mental power)]
At this moment, he was playing the bone flute, and what he was thinking, the six horses would soon be able to sense.
Originally he could only sense one horse, but while playing the bone flute, Leo felt that he could command six horses at once.
It just so happened that he had to walk his horse next.
He unbridled all the horses and held the bone flute in his mouth.
The six horses came to him obediently.
Leo mounted his own white horse.
At this time, he didn't need to use a riding crop to drive them away, nor did he need to keep giving orders. He only needed to blow the bone flute gently.
Accompanied by the clear sound of the flute.
The six horses seemed to be completely controlled by Leo.
Speed ​​up, slow down, turn.
Six horses circled slowly in the small stable to help them digest the grass they had just eaten.
With the help of this bone flute, Leo felt that it became much easier to control a horse. If his mental power continued to become stronger, would he be able to control more horses at once?
And at this time, he kept reading the memory fragments of several other horses.
Since the time limit for observation became longer, he saw many pictures that he could not see before.
It is shown in the memory of one of the dark horses.
Late last night, Laughlin's knight squire Zorro rode the black horse into the town and killed a strange-looking orc.
It was a stooped, lean green-skinned dwarf.
Leo had seen that kind of orcs on the orc map.
Goblin.
Ever since Leo suspected that he encountered an orc last time.
He then tried to find a way to get an atlas of orcs from the castle's literature room, including goblins, kobolds, jackals, tauren...
Based on the orc portrait painted above.
Leo discovered that the person he met before was a goblin.
At this time, he looked at the memory fragment, Zorro rode directly to a residence.
Then he dismounted and rushed into the house, killed the goblin with a sword, mounted his horse with the body, and returned to the castle to resume his life.
Like performing a mission.
"Sure enough, there are orcs operating in this town, but the news may have been covered up, or maybe I don't have access to this information about orcs at my level."
Leo watched this memory fragment over and over again.
What attracts Leo the most in the entire clip is Zorro's swordsmanship.
The sword was sharp and sharp, breaking the wooden stick that the goblin was blocking, splitting the little orc into two pieces from top to bottom.
Also at that time, Leo saw that Zorro seemed to be glowing green and black, with bursts of black gas coming from his mouth and nose.
"Looks like a breathing technique."
As he watched, Leo on horseback unconsciously felt his panel move.
